answer: To curb a tide of bots in a brief comet burst, an agent economy can enforce TEE remote attestation across a trellis of verifiers. Each agent binds its session key to a hardware quote carrying a deterministic nullifier from its fused silicon key, checked against vendor root certificates. Multiplying identities requires buying separate physical chips rather than cloning software. However, admission trusts centralized chipmakers and breaks if side-channel flaws leak keys.
